text:
maya: afternoon handoff — quick FYI: we saw a short APAC burst around 14:12 PDT. gpu-prod-2 hit burst limit twice, some queued jobs from customer `acme-ml` were throttled. keeping an eye on it for the next 3h :eyes:
liam: thanks maya. i'm taking evening coverage. can you paste the quick checks you ran? any ETA on queue drain?
samir: queue started at ~240 jobs, dropped to ~68 after scaling. running `rctl queue status acme-ml --pool gpu-prod-2` showed lots of small 1-2m jobs stacking. suspect client retry loop.
maya: ran these: `rctl pool util gpu-prod-2 --window 5m`, saw avg 87% with 2 spikes at 98% for ~90s. `rctl burst usage gpu-prod-2 --since 30m` -> burst used 85% of window. also temporarily raised per-tenant rate for acme-ml to avoid hard fails (manual override).
liam: got it. main risks: if another external batch runs while burst window still warm, we'll hit hard caps and new requests will queue or get 429. i'll watch dashboard and set a short autoscale bump if needed.
eva: FYI i'm on a deploy around 18:00 PDT that will touch routing rules. will avoid touching pool configs but ping me if you need a quick rollback. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: alert suppressed: gpu-prod-2 burst_threshold (14:12) — suppression by maya for 15m to prevent noisy duplicates.
liam: plan: 1) monitor `gpu-prod-2` util and burst_usage for the next 3h 2) if sustained >90% for >2m, trigger manual scale: `rctl pool scale gpu-prod-2 +2` (will reserve nodes; inform oncall) 3) if queue grows >150, reach out to infra-ops for temporary routing to gpu-standby.
maya: leaving pointer: logs for acme-ml jobs under /var/logs/queues/acme-ml (rotated) + `metrics.app.acme-ml.job_retry_rate` spike at 14:08. i left a short note on the customer ticket (#3248).
samir: i'm going to reach out to customer SRE to ask them to check retry config. ping me if i should escalate.
liam: thanks. i'll be here monitoring. if anyone wants to swap coverage later tonight (i might need 30m around 21:00 PDT), call out now.
eva: i can cover 21:00-21:30 if needed, i'm remote but available.
maya: thanks all. handing off — i've updated the oncall doc and the rotation board. :wave:
liam: acknowledged. leaving a short note in ops-queue channel when i scale.
